regime_context: China A-shares detector state as of 2026-09-30 shows a narrow leadership rotation: Banks (rank 1, crowded, durability 0.73) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, crowded) dominate, with only 4 of 22 themes eligible and absorption 0.32. The trust grade is critical here: gate_helps=false, so the trend discipline did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history — this tape mean-reverts and whipsaws the gate — and dir_accuracy on 77 past calls is only 0.377, so I default most views to low conviction and lean toward fewer theses.
emerging_watch: Coal (515220.SS) is the only eligible theme below the top ranks with a mean-revert tag and non-crowded status — watch whether its breadth expands above ~0.4 while staying eligible; if it breaks above a 5-day rolling high with breadth still fine, that ends the mean-revert read and turns it into a watchable trend candidate.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks hold the top momentum rank (0.998), broad breadth (0.889), and the highest durability bar (0.73), but they are flagged crowded (z=1.78) and the absolute-trend gate did not hold on this market's history. Given dir_accuracy of 0.377 on prior calls, the honest read is that chasing the crowded leader adds mean-reversion risk without a validated trend edge; the crowding flag is a size-down caution, not a short, so the cleanest expression is avoid rather than underweight.
evidence: gate_helps=false — trend discipline did not cut drawdown on this market's history
theses.dissent: Banks are the only durable, broad leadership story in a mean-reverting tape — avoid may leave the strongest relative shelter on the table if a risk-off rotation continues to favor value/safety names.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) closes up 3% or more while the CSI 300 is flat or down over the next 30 trading days, showing the crowded leader is not the vulnerable side

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO sits just behind Banks at rank 2 (0.988) and is also crowded (z=1.59), but its breadth is only 0.643 and the same mean-reverting, no-gate-edge regime applies. The rotation margin between leader and challenger is a razor-thin 0.01, yet rotation timing is explicitly display-only with no forward edge, so a handoff call cannot be justified. Avoid on the same crowded-leader reasoning as Banks.
evidence: Innovative Pharma & CXO rank 2, score 0.988, eligible=true
theses.dissent: Challenger themes with high rank and a thin margin to the leader sometimes complete the handoff; n=3 macro themes lean markets-centric and did not settle the case.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) closes up 3% or more while Banks (512800.SS) is flat or down over the next 30 trading days, showing the challenger has actually taken over

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics ranks 3 (0.682) with a hurst_tag of 'trend' but it is NOT eligible (eligible=false) because its durability_bar (0.28) is weak and breadth is only 0.059 — extremely narrow participation. With gate_helps=false and the basket extension showing no diversified-basket edge, a narrow, non-eligible trend theme in a mean-reverting tape is a fragility flag, so underweight is the accountable lean.
evidence: AI Compute & Optics rank 3, score 0.682, eligible=false
NOT crowded (z=-0.66), so this is a breadth/durability concern, not a crowding caution
theses.dissent: Non-crowded status plus a 'trend' hurst tag could mean the move is early and a low-crowding winner is forming under the radar — underweight may miss a genuine breakout.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS) closes up 5% or more while the CSI 300 is flat or down over the next 30 trading days, showing the narrow breadth did not cap the move
